title: Read the word marks
description: A, U and D mean Approved, Unknown and Disapproved. Only differing Texts results show an outcome cue and PanGloss line: ≠ with a solid underline for a new or different reading, ∅ with a dashed underline for no parse, and ◖ with a dotted underline for a stopped search. Staged means a choice is waiting for Apply.

steps.caption: A marks the approved FieldWorks reading. PanGloss built the same reading, so no decision is needed; matching results have no outcome mark or PanGloss line. A, U and D mean Approved, Unknown and Disapproved.

callouts.caption: Unread marks a word whose current reading has not been reviewed.
The word matches its approved FieldWorks reading, so it has no outcome mark or PanGloss line.
A means FieldWorks approved this reading. Choose Set analysis to change what FieldWorks holds.
FieldWorks shows its morphemes with a gloss below each one.

steps.caption: U means the reading is stored but not yet approved. PanGloss built the same reading, so there is no outcome mark or PanGloss line. Approve changes U to A.
